verdict.rationale: Rootly's own docs describe escalation policies with multi-step targets and time delays that decide what happens when an alert is not acknowledged in time. This covers the stepped walk-through and the fallback responders at later steps. Repeat rounds are not documented: round robin distributes pages among responders and is not the same as repeating the policy. Missing for 10: documented repeat/loop rounds until acknowledgment, detail on step behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, escalation policies walk unacknowledged pages through multiple steps — delays, fallback responders, and repeat rounds — until someone acknowledges

citations.quote: Escalation Policies define **how Rootly notifies responders when an alert requires attention** and what happens if that alert is not acknowledged in time.
Configure Rootly escalation policies with multi-step targets, time delays, and round robin to make sure on-call alerts get acknowledged and acted on.
Rootly On-Call now pages responders, posts alerts, and lets them acknowledge, escalate, and resolve right in Microsoft Teams.
